gloss: in turn; one after another; in order

definitions.gloss: in turn; one after another; in order; sequentially
definitions.explanation: Doing something in a fixed order, with each person or thing taking their turn one at a time.

examples.japanese: {順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The students presented one after another.

examples.japanese: {申込|もうしこ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けた→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{順々|じゅんじゅん}にご⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will serve you in turn, in the order applications were received.

notes:
Formed by reduplication of ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order, turn) plus the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The reduplication emphasizes the sequential, one-by-one nature of the process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in order
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to pass around in turn
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to proceed in order
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call one by one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in order — very similar; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に emphasizes the one-after-another rhythm more
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: one after another — implies rapid succession, possibly without a fixed order; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に implies a specific sequence
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: taking turns — implies rotation; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に implies a fixed sequence
